caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded earthenware pot with two small handles on opposite sides near the rim. The pot is tan or light brown in color, with a slightly darker brown rim. There is a decorative, painted design on the front featuring dark blue flowers with leaves and a stem, alongside the number "3" and the words “JACOB CAIRE POTTERY Poughkeepsie” written in black text near the upper part of the body. The pot sits within a faint rectangular frame on a cream or off-white background. In the upper right corner of the image, there is an inset detail showing a close-up section of the rim and handle attachment, rendered in similar tan shades. The artist’s name, "Yolande DeLasser," is written in capital letters in the lower left corner of the page.
title: Jar
